text:
zoe: quick thought - what if we standardize on an "edge adapter": JSON-friendly REST at the edge for public clients, and an internal typed gRPC lane for platform services. edge handles auth/tenant-quotas and lightweight validation.

ken: sounds good. main concerns: telemetry continuity and quota double-billing when both layers bill.

anya: telemetry fix: edge must add `x-rw-req` and `x-rollout` headers and forward span context. upstreams echo the req id so traces stitch. also add `x-pool` in responses for debugging.

maria: quota idea: edge issues a provisional debit id header `x-provisional-debit` when pre-checking. upstream either commits or voids that id so quota service can reconcile. prevents double-charge.

ken: UX/Console needs: a per-route rollout slider that writes a `rollout-id` policy; Console should show pool-level p50/p95 and provisional-debit failures.

zoe: gateway should support grpc-web + json->proto transcoding, but allow a fastpath to forward raw JSON to REST pools when tenant opts out.

ops-bot: infra note: will need an Envoy filter + small transcoder service. canary to dev first.

maria: propose 1-week spike: implement headers, provisional debit mock, simple Console panel. if perf impact <5ms p50, escalate to wider POC.
